entities.summary: Theodorus Bernardus Maria "Theo" Terlingen was a field hockey player from the Netherlands. He competed at the 1960, 1964 and 1968 Summer Olympics where his team finished in ninth, seventh and fifth place, respectively. A defense player, he scored two goals in 1964 and one in 1968.
